subject: Batches 1-2 integrated (acb5396 renal, 281db11 endocrine): 324 items, 56 sections, 399 cards, 25 figures; all 11/15 leaves at or above min
body:
# S23-C batches 1-2 integrated: renal (11) and endocrine (15)

Commits on claude/naadi-shared: acb5396 (renal), 281db11 (endocrine); test fix f35acaa before them.
Pack `data/content/renal-endo-nutrition`; authoring source `src/<code>.json`, one per area; `build.py` writes the pack files.

| | Renal 11 | Endocrine 15 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sections | 28 | 28 | 56 |
| Items (Step 1 / Step 2 CK) | 172 (92 / 80) | 152 (61 / 91) | 324 (153 / 171) |
| Sequential sets | 10 | 10 | 20 |
| Flashcards | 194 | 205 | 399 |
| Original SVG figures | 12 | 13 | 25 |

Coverage (`validate_content.py --areas`, counts include legacy items): every leaf in 11 and 15 is at or above
min 6 on both Steps. Below target but above min: 11.01.01 s1 9/11, 11.03.01 s1 9/10, 15.06 s2 9/10.
Retags in pack.json: 9 legacy items (GN items to 11.01.02, RCC to 11.02.02, ADPKD to 11.02.01, stones to 11.04.01).

Checks: validator 0 errors (412 advisory lint warnings, mostly L10 option-type mixing and L05 key length; I'm
working them down); seed tests + tests/content green; import on a fresh local stack, second run 0 changes; all 28
renal sections rendered in WebKit and Chromium at iPad portrait, iPad landscape and phone 390 with no page overflow,
no broken figures and no console errors. Every SVG was rendered and checked for clipped or overlapping text.
Endocrine sections are rendered in the next pass. Two existing issues are not from content: the admin question page
overflows at phone width in WebKit (legacy items too), and WebKit logs one CSP style-src warning on every page.

Difficulty spread (all 324): 1: about 15%, 2: about 34%, 3: about 36%, 4: about 14%, 5: under 1%. I'll add
harder items in the top-up pass.

## For the medical reviewer: facts the authors flagged as worth checking
- 11.01.02: KDIGO 2025 IgAN targets (BP below about 120-130 systolic; proteinuria escalation above about 0.5-1 g/day);
  membranous prophylactic anticoagulation at albumin below about 2.0-2.5 g/dL; nephrin antibodies in MCD wording.
- 11.03.01: AUA microhematuria high-risk cut-offs (60 years or older, more than 30 pack-years, more than 25 RBC/hpf).
- 11.04.01: finerenone eGFR 25 or more; SGLT2i at eGFR 20 or more with ACR 200 or more or HF; SBP below 120;
  ESA at Hb below about 10; bicarbonate below 18; tamsulosin for distal 5-10 mm stones.
- 11.02.01: ADPKD BP about 110/75 when young with preserved GFR; tolvaptan LFTs monthly for 18 months.
- 11.06/11.07: VUR imaging after a first febrile UTI (ultrasound first, VCUG if abnormal); amnioinfusion wording.
- 11.08.01: contrast AKI prevention (no bicarbonate, NAC of no benefit); checkpoint-inhibitor AIN grading.
- 15.01.01: HHS osmolality wording; dextrose at 250 (DKA) or 300 (HHS) mg/dL; SGLT2i hold 3 days (4 for ertugliflozin).
- 15.02.01: ATA FNA size thresholds by sonographic pattern; subclinical hyperthyroidism treatment thresholds.
- 15.03.01: parathyroidectomy criteria; USPSTF 2025 osteoporosis screening wording.
- 15.04.01: 2025 Endocrine Society primary-aldosteronism screening breadth; cosyntropin cut-off (18, or 14-15 with
  newer assays); CAH stress dose.
- 15.05/15.06: SIADH correction limits (8 high risk, 10-12 others); GH suppression below about 1 ng/mL.
- 15.07: RET-class thyroidectomy timing (M918T first year; codon 634 by about age 5).

Next: batch 3 is nutrition (16.04.*) and fluids/electrolytes/acid-base (16.07.*). It waits for seg23-d's decision
on contract 20261117T132853. In parallel I'm doing a 10% self-review sample and render-checking the endocrine sections.
